quest.title: Adventurer Exam: Battle Tactics
quest.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Anna, please reconsider. We should really take the long-term view here...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, come on! Stop worrying, already. I'll be fine!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Traveler! You're just in time! Please, you've got to help me out here. Anna wants to become an adventurer!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: And why can't I be an adventurer? I'm as healthy as can be, and Cyrus says I've got the mind for the job, too!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: You haven't even been well for that long! What are you going to do if you fall ill again? Besides, there's no way our parents will agree!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Come on, I've already talked to Mom and Dad about this. They say they'll allow it as long as I pass the Adventurers' Guild selection trials.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Wh... What!?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Cyrus helped me get a training schedule set up a few days back. I've been training ever since then.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: That said, it's all been scouting work, foraging for emergency rations, outdoor survival, and stuff like that...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: But I've heard that adventurers also do battle with monsters out in the wild often, too.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: I'd love to learn how to do that, but I haven't found anyone who'll teach me...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: And as you can see, my brother...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I won't have it! Those monsters are highly dangerous! Even if you do go, you'll have to make sure you're accompanied by a seasoned veteran at the very least!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: I mean, I've asked Jack! He agreed to help me.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Oh, get real. I know who Jack is. He can barely take care of himself out there, let alone you.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Well, I doubt we'll find any veteran adventurers that easily at the Guild, and I don't have the funds to put a commission up...

choices.text: Hmm. Why don't I come with you?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Eh? You'd help me out! That's great!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Alright then, brother, guess you can rest easy now!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Well...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: #*sigh* Alright, alright. I know how strong the Honorary Knight is. With {F#her}{M#him} by your side, I suppose I can rest a little easier.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: However, you should still be careful out there...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Do you remember everything I told you?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Yeah, yeah, I remember them... You've talked my ear off several times already!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Alright then, Traveler, let's head out right now! I've had Jack check out the encampment we're going to.

choices.text: I've got some confidence in my skills.
In that case, how's your training going?
What are you two talking about, Anthony?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow, you beat them all down — you made it look pretty easy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: It's just as the handbook says — you can use all sorts of ways and means to beat monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Still, I've got to admit that they still scare me when they're this close. It's a good thing we've got you around...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Yup, I know. The road to becoming an adventurer is far from easy.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler! I'll head back to the city now. I'm sure my brother's worried sick by now...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I've got to train harder from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow, you beat them all down — you made it look pretty easy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: You just went at them head-on... It's nice to be strong, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Still, I've got to admit that they still scare me when they're this close. It's a good thing we've got you around...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Yup, I know. The road to becoming an adventurer is far from easy.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler! I'll head back to the city now. I'm sure my brother's worried sick by now...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I've got to train harder from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I'm leaving Anna in your care, Traveler. Please make sure that she doesn't come to any harm.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: *sigh* She's only been well for a short while, and she's already causing havoc...
